title: WebView loads a computed URL in kotlin — review required
description: WebView.loadUrl receives a URL that is not a literal. A URL taken from an intent extra, deep link, or message can navigate the embedded browser to an attacker origin that then receives injected JavaScript bridge access or phishing content. The rule flags the non-literal load; the provenance of the URL is a review decision.
remediation: Allowlist scheme and host before loadUrl, reject javascript: and file: URLs, and keep JavaScript bridges disabled for untrusted content.
limitation: Lexical: matches a non-literal argument on one line; URLs assembled in helpers are out of scope.
